# Beit Kultur website – school project (Berghs)

- Stack: SvelteKit, GitHub, Vercel, Neon PostgreSQL.
- Everything is test mode. No real payments. Donations are a simple
  form that saves amount + date to Neon.
- Never put API keys or database passwords in code. Use .env and
  keep .env in .gitignore.
- I have dyslexia: explain changes in short, simple sentences.
- Make small changes, one feature at a time.
- After each change, tell me what files changed and why.
